content.comment_body: Hello, Here are the required points: Digital Input - 36 Analog Input - 3 Digital Output - 16 Analog Output - 0 For selecting a controller: [article_no] - 2 units DM16 - 3 units Can I create one program using two [article_no] controllers? If so, please explain.

If my understanding is correct, you're asking how to create a network connection. There’s more to it than just establishing a network. Which method do you want to use? Master/Slave: Only the master controller requires a program. This is easier to set up, but you can’t fully utilize both controllers. The slave controller shares its hardware resources, including expansion modules, with the master. If the master stops functioning, the slave will no longer operate. Master/Master: Both controllers run their own programs and each operates independently, using its full potential. If one fails, the other continues working.
Thank you for your reply. I’d like to use the master/slave program setup.
You can refer to an example in the video attached. Set the slave controller to slave mode using the menu or with the configuration software.
